findings.namedBuyers: Two strongest verified commercial routing contacts: Oli Maynard-Langedijk, Director, Business Development & Partnerships (JA Canada national directory), and Erin Barton, Chief Development Officer (both official directories). Their relevance is partnership/sponsorship and development leadership, not proven hotel-contract authority. CBHF separately lists Oliver Maynard-Langedijk under the older/different title Manager, Sponsorships & Business Development. Sophie Fretwell remains listed on CBHF as Manager, Canadian Business Hall of Fame, but is absent from the national directory and a 2026/10 recruitment document seeks a CBHF & Events manager: confirm the operational incumbent before routing to her. Scott Hillier and Claudia Campbell are secondary leadership/marketing contacts, not established lodging buyers.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced upcoming edition: Thursday, May 27, 2027, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Cocktail reception 5:00 pm; dinner program 6:00–9:00 pm. This is the activity date, not a release date, and falls within the requested horizon. No officially announced 2028 edition was located; do not extrapolate an exact 2028 date.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications and the published event format: a downtown Harbourfront city hotel can plausibly serve a small subset of travelling honourees, executives, sponsors, staff or guests attending MTCC; an off-site resort proposition is not aligned with this evening downtown programme. Radisson Blu’s supplied 157 guestrooms and approximately 224-person banquet capacity cannot house the entire audience on a one-person-per-room basis or host the published 700-plus-person gala. Appropriate roles are a separately verified modest room block, VIP lodging or small side meetings—not exclusive housing or the main dinner. The supplied 15–109 peak-room range is a sales-fit envelope, NOT event demand. No event-specific overnight conversion or room demand can be estimated defensibly. Do not promise catering or a reception until restaurant/lounge and banquet-service capability are verified.
findings.venueCommitments: Published 2027 venue: Metro Toronto Convention Centre, North Building, Lower Level, 255 Front St. West, Toronto, Ontario. This is downtown Toronto proper, within the MTCC territory, not an outlying municipality or a hotel. The organizer announcement establishes a named venue commitment, not access to its contract or proof of exclusivity. Gala venue replacement is not an evidenced opportunity.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified sequence: May 11, 2023 (44th), May 23, 2024 (45th), May 22, 2025 (46th), and May 28, 2026 (47th), all at Metro Toronto Convention Centre, Toronto, Ontario. The announced 2027 edition remains at MTCC. This evidence shows repeat Toronto/MTCC use, not destination rotation; historical sub-building/room assignments were not established. Annual recurrence is expressly described by the organizer, rather than inferred solely from date patterns.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown for 2027. No edition-specific host hotel, hotel block, booking link/code, housing bureau, accommodation RFP, peak-room count or room-night figure was located in the official event/participation pages or targeted lodging searches. No hotels can therefore be listed as committed. The participation page says “Early bird sponsorship opportunities now available”; this is sponsorship availability, NOT hotel sourcing. The event page says “Individual table and tickets are available for purchase”; this is gala admission, NOT accommodation. JA Canada’s event-manager role explicitly includes “Manage venue, production, décor, food & beverage, AV vendors and entertainment,” establishing an internal event-vendor pathway but not identifying lodging responsibility. Absence of published lodging information does not establish open sourcing or absence of private arrangements.
findings.organizationStructure: JA Canada owns and operates CBHF, overseen by a Governance Committee of the JA Canada Board. The induction celebration is JA Canada’s signature fundraising event: a nonprofit-owned business-leadership gala, not a corporate-owned convention or an identified PCO/DMC. MTCC is the announced venue, not the event owner or a demonstrated housing buyer. The recruitment document places event management internally, reporting to Marketing and working with Resource Development/Sponsorship. No appointed accommodation intermediary or PCO was established.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The principal established constraint is the announced MTCC gala venue and its repeated historical use. No incumbent accommodation hotel, housing exclusivity, sold-out hotel, displaced block or actual overflow demand was found. Attendance does not equal overnight demand; a single-evening gala may generate limited accommodation, but the local/travelling split is unknown. Do not label Radisson Blu an official or overflow hotel without organizer evidence.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Oli Maynard-Langedijk at the publicly listed omaynard@jacanada.org, with Erin Barton (ebarton@jacanada.org) as a senior development routing alternative, and use info@cbhf.ca for the operational handoff. Ask who currently manages 2027 event logistics and hotel contracting; confirm whether honourees, sponsors, staff or guests need Toronto overnight rooms, who pays/books, existing hotel commitments, dates, peak rooms, rate parameters and decision timing. Only after a positive needs check, offer a right-sized VIP/delegate room-block proposal near MTCC; discuss side-meeting space separately and subject to service verification. Ask when the next accommodation review occurs for later annual cycles, without claiming a published 2028 event or an open RFP.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the upcoming 2027 edition, sponsorship engagement is publicly available, but neither hotel procurement access nor a lodging requirement is confirmed. Treat as an organizer-qualification / relationship-development lead for guestrooms only, not sales-ready open venue business. The announced MTCC dinner should not be displaced in the sales proposition.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: verified annual recurrence and repeated MTCC use support cultivating a repeat accommodation relationship, conditional on a real out-of-town guest cohort and an uncommitted lodging pathway. They do not establish a future room block or movable gala. For 2028, no officially published date, city or venue was located; keep those future-edition values null and pursue planning-window intelligence rather than inventing an edition.
